proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Got rear-ended on Woodward in January. They called my insurance before I even got home, and when they found a bent reinforcement bar behind the bumper they sent me a photo and handled the extra with the adjuster. I never had to argue with anybody.
reviews.name: Latoya B.

reviews.text: Hit a deer on the way back from Port Huron. The tape on my hood said 'station 6, day 4' when I stopped by, which made me laugh, but it was right. Car came back on day seven.
reviews.name: Marek S.

reviews.text: My rockers were going from twelve winters of salt. Teodor showed me where the metal was still good and where it wasn't, cut out only the bad part and quoted it before he started. Nothing came back through this past winter.
reviews.name: Gerald W.

reviews.text: The new door is the same silver as the fender, in the shop and in the Kroger lot in daylight. They showed me the test card next to my car before they painted.
reviews.name: Hiba A.

reviews.text: Two dings from a shopping cart, pushed out in about an hour while I waited. You genuinely cannot find where they were.
reviews.name: Colin F.

reviews.text: Slid into a curb on an icy morning and cracked the bumper and a parking sensor. They fixed the cover instead of replacing it, recalibrated the sensor, and the bill was lower than the app estimate my insurer gave me.
reviews.name: Renata P.

proof.guarantee: Paint and body work we do is covered for as long as you own the car. If it fails, we fix it.
